title: dataset
description: A FROZEN selection of items. The dataset_id is the comparison contract: two metrics are only comparable if they name the same dataset_id. An item's identity is its item_id and source_sha256; its fields describe it and are not part of that identity (ADR-0003).

version.description: The content version MAJOR.MINOR, two integers (1.10 follows 1.9): 1.0 for a dataset made from nothing or a side of a split; from a parent (derived_from), MINOR + 1 when items were only added, MAJOR + 1 and MINOR 0 when any was removed or changed, the parent's when the items are the same. Not changed by the card, licence or description. Recomputed by validate (V22); a source's own version is source.revision.

licence.description: Optional: an SPDX id from evh licences, unknown (the source states none), or LicenseRef-<name> for a licence of its own. Changed by evh dataset-describe without a new version (E3); checked by validate (V22).

source.description: Where the items came from (E1), the same keys for every source; a value nobody recorded is null. provider names the source (huggingface, kaggle, openml, croissant, url, folder, a project's own), ref its name for the dataset, revision its own version of it (never this dataset's version), gated whether reading it needs an agreement, description_sha256 the hash of its description as read, item_url a template for one item's page with {row} (the item's source_row) or {item_id}.

card.description: The datasheet questions answered (E4), under Croissant RAI 1.0's property names without the rai: prefix; all optional. Changed by evh dataset-describe --card without a new version.

published.description: Where the dataset was published (evh dataset-publish, P1), each read back and matching: no new version.

fieldset.description: the field set (data/fields/<fieldset>.yaml) that declares the items' fields

fields_sha256.description: one hash over every item's fields, so a change to them is visible

derived_from.description: The dataset this version was made from (dataset-create --from), and what changed: the item ids added, removed, and kept with different bytes.

tags.description: What the dataset is, as key=value pairs a project chooses (source, environment, purpose, owner): shown and filtered on, never part of its identity. Items carry their own tags (a list) below.

split.description: This dataset is one side of a split (evh dataset-split, RFC-019): the parent, the share, the rule.

from_version.description: the parent's version when the split was made

text.description: hidden: no text that comes from this dataset (items, outputs, reference texts and labels, judge reasons, source links, text and URL field values) appears on any public surface (RFC-019 §4). Default shown.

extended_from.description: The version this one grew from and the picks it added (evh dataset-extend, RFC-023): per added item its dataset, the capture it came from and the pick's note.

made_from.description: How the items were chosen when the dataset was made from a capture (evh dataset-from-capture, RFC-019): the capture, its query, and the selection rules.

source_url.description: where materialize fetches the item from; its bytes must hash to source_sha256

source_row.description: the item's row (or id) at its source, filled into source.item_url's {row}

fields.description: values of the dataset's declared fields
